description: Host half of the console merge: same-origin share routes that proxy the RedTeam runner console's /api surface to the chat client with the console bearer attached server-side, plus an allowlisted bridge to the console's three read-only Arsenal MCP tools. The browser never sees the console endpoint's token.
name: @secscan/redteam-console-share

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsdown && node ../scripts/dist-hash.mjs write . lib
